name: prepare on an unpaid reference with an attempt names that attempt
note: Exercise the real repository and request handler. Commit the settled-golden checkout 7f..7f (created_at 900, expires_at 1500) and do NOT settle it, then preclaim the gate; wallet I/O must not occur. The host prices the reference at 1 sat. A page reloaded after the payer paid opens on the picker and polls this hash, so the receipt still comes.
